episode_title: Why We Applied to The SHIFT! ☕ | The Contestants Share Their Tea
question: What made contestants apply to The Shift season two and how did they react when selected?
transcript_excerpt: Christian was suggested by his clinical director and applied to push himself out of his comfort zone, shocked he was selected. Kyle watched season one and applied after seeing the opportunity posted by his program director, initially thinking his joke answers wouldn't get selected. Taya found out through an email from Joe to Texas State's administration and told herself there was no harm in applying. Shelby was posted about through her university announcements and also decided to take the opportunity while available as a student.

question: What would The Shift season two contestants do with the $5,000 grand prize if they won?
transcript_excerpt: Christian would spend on an all-you-can-eat seafood buffet and save the rest. Kyle would fix his problematic car that troubled him throughout RT school and spoil himself. Taya would go on a vacation after graduation and treat the people who helped her through her program. Shelby would have a lavish dinner with family on a white sandy beach and celebrate with everyone who supported her.

episode_title: Why We Applied to The SHIFT! ☕ | The Contestants Share Their Tea
question: How has respiratory therapy differed from what The Shift season two contestants expected entering the profession?
transcript_excerpt: Christian expected boring button pushers or neb jockeys but found it much more fulfilling, with every clinical shift providing purpose. Kyle was initially led to respiratory after being waitlisted for PA programs and discovered RTs are involved across the board from labs to rounds and life-saving events. Taya noted the profession is better than a normal nine-to-five with opportunities to help people on their worst days. Kyle emphasized respiratory therapists are heavily involved beyond just breathing and treatments, being first responders in life-saving situations.

episode_title: Why We Applied to The SHIFT! ☕ | The Contestants Share Their Tea
question: What lessons do The Shift season two contestants want viewers to learn about respiratory therapy careers?
transcript_excerpt: Christian emphasized the importance of sleep and being ready for anything, as crazy clinical days happen regularly. Taya highlighted that there is no single correct path to success and that students should learn from failure. Kyle stressed the importance of teamwork with people you meet on the job, whether they are equally inexperienced or highly experienced. Shelby noted that respiratory care offers numerous daily learning opportunities and should never be treated as autopilot work.
